newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Frontier says more Vietnam oil shows.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Frontier says more Vietnam oil shows.

text.p: Oil and gas explorers Frontier Petroleum NL and Anzoil NL advised on Monday that drilling at the Song Thai Bin B10-1X well in the Hanoi Basin in onshore Vietnam had located additional oil shows.
The well operator, Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd, said good oil shows with minor gas shows were recorded while drilling over an interval between 1,225 metres to 1,245 metres.
Anzoil said the shows became intermittent to 1,269 metres and three deeper thin limestone belts exhibited minor gas peaks, oil fluoresence and solvent cut but left no oil residue.

"The significance of these shows will be assessed with electric logs and pressure measurements which will be recorded after reaching the revised planned total depth of 1,450 metres," Frontier said in a statement.

Frontier said a drill stem test prepared over the 1220-1230 metre interval in the well recovered eight barrels of oil and a small amount of gas was flared but no formation water recovered. Anzoil (Asia) Pte Ltd is owned 20 percent by Frontier and 80 percent by Anzoil NL.
Thai Binh B10-1X is l6 km north-north east of the recent gas discovery at the Song Tra Ly D14-1X well.

At 12.20 p.m. (0220 GMT), Anzoil shares were two cents down at 16 cents on turnover of 3.72 million shares, while Frontier shares were 3.5 cents lower at 22.5 cents on turnover of 2.28 million shares.
